# QuickPDF

> Privacy-first PDF utilities that run entirely in the user's browser.
> No accounts, no uploads, no server-side storage.

Site: https://quickpdf.info
Contact: hello@quickpdf.info (replace with your address)

## Tools

- Merge PDF (/merge.html): combine multiple PDFs into one.
- Split PDF (/split.html): extract page ranges into a new PDF.
- Compress PDF (/compress.html): rasterise pages to JPEG to reduce size. Text becomes non-selectable.
- OCR PDF (/ocr.html): English text extraction using Tesseract.js WebAssembly.
- Sign PDF (/sign.html): draw, type, or upload a signature. Signatures stored in browser IndexedDB.
- Images to PDF (/images-to-pdf.html): JPG, PNG, and WebP converted to a single PDF.
- PDF Information (/pdf-info.html): page count, metadata, page dimensions.

## Guarantees

- No file content leaves the device. All processing uses JavaScript and WebAssembly in the browser.
- No accounts, no cookies for tracking, no analytics.
- Works offline after first load (service worker).
- Password-protected PDFs are rejected deliberately.

## Limits

- Compression quality is below Adobe Acrobat / Ghostscript.
- OCR accuracy depends on scan quality. English only in v1.
- Files over ~150 MB may exhaust browser memory.
- PDF forms, embedded JavaScript, 3D content, and file attachments are not preserved.
